title: Winning with AI · Trainer check
note: Part A knowledge check: the same 10 questions at the start of Day 1 and the end of Day 2 of the ToT. Keys stay on the server. These match the ToT package as of 27 Oct 2026; they may be replaced with harder scenario questions later, so load them from this file, never hard-code them in the UI.

questions.text: What do founders do on a practice slide?

options.c: Do the task on their own business and type it into their copy
options.d: Discuss it in groups, without writing

questions.text: You are 5 minutes behind in a module. What do you do?

options.a: Use the "cut first" item in the notes and keep the "never cut" part

questions.text: At the end of each part, how do you find out who needs your help next?

options.a: Read every worksheet during the break
options.d: A show of hands on the part's "Done when", then visit those who did not reach it

questions.text: A participant is about to paste a list of customer names into AI. You:

options.b: Stop them and have them replace the names with codes first
options.d: Mention it at the end of the day

questions.text: How do you say course terms in Arabic?

options.a: Exactly as the Launch Kit glossary has them

questions.text: When participants test an AI on 10 examples, an "Unsure" answer from the AI counts as:
What is the difference between "pass mark" and "target" in this course?

options.b: Pass mark is for tests on people; target is for AI test scores
options.c: Pass mark is for AI; target is for sales
options.d: Target is set after the results

questions.text: In a live demo, the AI does not make the mistake you planned to show. You:

options.c: Show the prepared example from the speaker notes and move on
options.d: Skip the rest of the lab

questions.text: Why does every AI test run in a new, temporary chat?

options.a: So earlier answers and saved memory cannot change the result

questions.text: What decides whether a participant's AI helper may start answering customers?

options.d: All 10 test messages answered safely, and all four go-live checks passed
